title: RatiometricCaImagingSingleTimepoint: MATLAB analysis routine for ratiometric Fluo-4/Fura-Red calcium imaging
description: MATLAB routine for ratiometric intracellular calcium analysis of single-timepoint confocal images using the Fluo-4 / Fura-Red dye pair. Performs automated cell segmentation by thresholding and distance-transform watershed, background-corrected fluorescence quantification on raw channel data, and per-cell export of the Fluo-4/Fura-Red intensity ratio together with morphological descriptors. Written by Nicole Suzanne Sarna, Department of Bioengineering, Rice University (laboratory of Dr. Michael R. King).
